Efficiency / F02

Efficiency has
many denominators.

A cheaper token, a better financial ratio and a lower energy bill per useful task are different claims. This view keeps each measure in its own unit and says which ones the evidence can and cannot fill. Today only the financial ratio has located values.

F02 / Denominator comparison

Six measures, one row each.

No row is converted into another. A blank is written as unknown with the reason, not filled from a neighbouring row.

Why the rows do not convert

For a fixed workload: attempts A = S / s, facility energy E = A × I × p, and task cost = A × price per attempt. The financial ratio has none of S, s, I or p in it, so it cannot be turned into task cost or energy without inventing them. See the identity in the rebound lab →

What would fill the unknown rows

An adopted workload rubric (draft ↗), dated prices and token counts per attempt, measured success under matched protocols, delivered-capacity disclosures, and metered or well-bounded energy per attempt. None is in hand.
